name: Daily phonemic-body practice (30–40 min)
breath_policy: Do not force 1:4:2 during nyāsa. Let phonation lengthen the exhale. Separate prāṇāyāma only if completely comfortable (TĀ 4.91).

steps.label: Seat + stillness
steps.detail: Spine long, jaw soft, teeth not clenched. One intention: install sound-objects in the body.

steps.label: Phonetic embodiment — feel articulation
steps.detail: Speak each varga slowly. Ask: where is this sound physically made? Train phonemic interoception. Do NOT start with subtle-body visualization.

steps.label: VBT breath axis — saḥ / haṃ
steps.detail: Comfortable breath only. Out: heart → saḥ → external dvādaśānta. Natural turn. In: haṃ → heart. Natural turn. Establish audio-respiratory carrier. No heroic retention.
steps.source: Vijñānabhairava 24–25 (Lakshmanjoo oral: outward saḥ, inward haṃ)

steps.label: Mātṛkā nyāsa — external (touch + glyph + sound + locus)
steps.detail: Right hand lightly indicates each locus. At each: see Devanāgarī glyph internally + pronounce once + feel location. Primary visual object = the Sanskrit character.
steps.month: 1 — vowels across head/face first, then one varga every few days

steps.label: Internal nyāsa — no touching
steps.detail: Eyes closed. Run the same procession mentally. Glyph lights the locus. Goal: whole alphabet like a scale on an instrument.

steps.label: Laya / absorption — stop manipulating
steps.detail: Natural breath. One locus or the residual glyph field. Return without drama when mind wanders.

steps.label: One-line log
steps.detail: phoneme/row worked | easiest locus | vocal depth reached | any tension
